info.title: SysAgent Guard evidence OpenAPI (mock)
info.description: Local sysak collection -> authenticated loopback HTTP -> parsed real resource and diagnostic HealthState. Independent AgentSight evidence -> POST /openapi/v1/agent-diagnostics -> shared AgentDiagnostic using deterministic local rules, without sysak device snapshots or revisions. AgentSight is not sysak evidence and never changes its snapshot state. mode: mock identifies local deployment, not simulated measurements; state.mode is collected and task.simulated is false. Read-only snapshot, reset, inspect and independent agent-diagnose are supported; cleanup, optimization and simulated mutations return 409 read_only. Missing measurements are null with availability metadata, never demo values. Successful Agent parsing does not assert health or confirm a fault root cause. All routes require Bearer authentication, bind only to 127.0.0.1, reject Origin headers, and emit JSON with Cache-Control: no-store. No raw snapshots or tokens are logged or persisted. Tasks complete synchronously (HTTP 200), sharing a maximum 100 retained results/tasks across evidence routes. The server never invokes collectors, LLMs, external services, shell commands, resolve, restart or process actions.

port.description: Actual ephemeral or configured loopback port returned by startMockOpenApi; 8787 is illustrative only.

post.summary: Parse a local sysak snapshot and return real resource state
post.description: Uncompressed UTF-8 JSON: request maximum 10 MiB, original raw_snapshot value including internal whitespace maximum 8 MiB. Raw request_id exactly matches outer request_id. Outer persistent device UUID supplies receipt.device.id; collection.finished_at supplies collected_at and sampledAt. Raw evidence is not rewritten. inspect, snapshot and reset all accept the single idc_inspect inspection profile. A failed collection returns 503 without commit; partial is accepted with explicit unavailable measurements. Parse cpu.total.usage_pct, memory total_kb-available_kb, the root entry of disk.mounts, fd allocated/max plus per-process fd_count/fd_limit, gpu nvidia-smi device facts, energy package-only RAPL watts, and process.top_cpu/top_rss plus io.by_disk/by_vfs rankings keyed by pid+starttime. Agent/Session attribution is not implemented. Inspection derives root/memory/FD/log/GPU items from those same 1.1 sections; network, io and agents diagnoses remain unchecked, and GPU job-level ai analysis stays not_run because current idc_inspect emits no diagnostics.ai. Successful fresh requests increment revision (initial snapshot/reset: 1); replay preserves its original revision and does not replace latest snapshot. Resources refresh preserves independent inspection results; reset clears inspection history without reducing revision. hasGpu is inferred from evidence, not the optional UI hint. snapshot/reset revision optional; inspect and legacy write requests require positive matching revision checked before raw interpretation. Legacy write operations return 409 read_only, never commit. Capacity 32 devices, retryable 503 on overflow; last 100 successful requests/tasks retained FIFO. Case-insensitive UUID replay lookup requires exactly identical body bytes, otherwise 409; replay does not refresh FIFO or latest snapshot. Evicted tasks return 404. Raw data is neither returned nor retained.

post.summary: Interpret independent AgentSight evidence using local read-only rules
post.description: AgentSight is not a sysak collector. No existing device snapshot or revision is required; this route never reads or changes sysak snapshot state or consumes device capacity. Uncompressed UTF-8 JSON: 10 MiB request, 8 MiB original raw_snapshot including whitespace. request_id shares the last-100 FIFO result/task cache with collections; identical bytes on the same route replay, different bytes or route return 409. Successful submission means parsing completed, NOT Agent health. Missing sources are unavailable, malformed individual sources fail closed as invalid without interpreting any of their rows. Oversized or upstream truncated AgentSight lists are bounded and explicitly truncated, not complete. process/session/interruption/latency limits: 256/500/200/256; latency is an array of agent-group complete-call summaries. Sessions and Token totals describe only the complete collected session list (usually upstream 24h, including auxiliary calls and cached input usage), not session lifetime totals; truncated session totals are null. Calls without reported usage may be recorded as zero. Whole-window unresolved/critical/high totals come only from valid complete interruptionCounts, never the 200-row unresolved list. Null metrics remain null. Nanosecond numeric precision is used only for timestamp display, not IDs. Zero or older-than-2-minute scan yields unknown probe conclusions; this threshold measures freshness only. healthy means any HTTP status response, no_port may be a normal CLI, offline without has_crash is not a crash. hung/unhealthy, offline with has_crash and unresolved events produce observations and manual suggestions, never confirmed root causes. Five valid complete AgentSight sources yield status ok, some usable sources partial, none unavailable. Optional top-level raw_snapshot.hooks carries independent metadata only, never a sources entry: at most 5000 events, 16 agents, latest 200 report events. Any malformed Hook source, invalid row/ID/window, duplicate ID or exceeded Hook limit returns HTTP 200 with hooks.invalid and empty Hook evidence, without rejecting the request or changing AgentSight coverage/status. Hook metadata contains no prompt text, tool I/O, error body or token usage and is never linked to AgentSight process/session identities. Hook tool failure, cancellation, permission denial and unmatched starts alone do not prove Agent fault or hang; turn failures are recorded observations, not confirmed root causes. No data yields unknown. No LLM, external calls, resolve, restart or process operations. Raw evidence is neither returned nor retained.

200.description: Completed interpretation, including partial/unavailable evidence; not a health assertion

get.summary: Get the last successful parsed resource state

200.description: Last committed response; a replay does not replace it

get.summary: Get a retained synchronous task; no raw snapshot is retained
Declare supported read-only collection operations and profiles

200.description: Mock capabilities, not remote command permissions

BearerAuth.description: Mandatory opaque local token, compared using timingSafeEqual on SHA-256 digests. Not a query parameter; never logged.

NoStore.description: All success and error responses disable caching

BadRequest.description: Malformed UTF-8/JSON, schema, UUID, profile, parameters, IDs or protected selection

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid Bearer authentication (checked on every route before other validation)

Forbidden.description: Origin headers are forbidden; no CORS headers are emitted

NotFound.description: Unknown route, uninitialized device or evicted/unknown task

MethodNotAllowed.description: Wrong method; Allow header identifies the supported method

Conflict.description: revision_conflict, idempotency_conflict or read_only; no state committed

TooLarge.description: Request exceeds 10 MiB or original raw_snapshot JSON value exceeds 8 MiB

Unavailable.description: collection_failed, device_capacity or service_unavailable; retryable true, no successful state commit

Version.description: sysAK idc_inspect collection envelope and collection-route responses.

AgentVersion.description: Independent AgentSight evidence contract; unchanged by the sysAK collection upgrade.

AnyVersion.description: Error envelopes echo the schema of the route that failed.

EvidenceId.description: App-generated UUID, or the 32-hex server inspection_id that sysAK writes into request_id after a successful pre-environment upload.

Profile.description: idc_inspect default mode always emits the inspection profile; there is no separate resources profile.

hasGpu.description: Optional UI hint accepted but not used to override actual GPU evidence.

device_id.description: App-persistent random UUID, independent of raw device metadata; supplies receipt.device.id.

Permissions.description: Collector-reported permissions, not server privileges. Propagated only as receipt metadata; partial/denied permissions do not turn partial collection into full success.

Collector.description: Metadata from the local allowlisted sysak idc_inspect collector, invoked as the current user. Extra collector metadata is accepted but not echoed. This mock does not authenticate hardware provenance and never invokes a collector or shell.

Device.description: Opaque local sysAK metadata: platform, machine, hostname and scope: local. No id is emitted or required; receipt.device.id comes from outer device_id. Device metadata is not echoed.

RawSnapshot.description: Structured sysAK idc_inspect schema 1.1 envelope, preserved unchanged. host is top-level; every other section lives under sections with its data inline beside status/reason/detail (no 1.0 content wrapper). collection.finished_at is the completion timestamp. cpu, memory, disk and fd sections must be objects even when unavailable. Known facts are parsed; unknown fields are not echoed. No arbitrary command API. Limits apply to original UTF-8 JSON bytes. Invalid or missing individual measurements become unavailable, not successful zero samples.

request_id.description: Must exactly match the outer request_id, including when sysAK overwrote it with the server inspection_id.

collection.description: Collector also emits started_at, duration_ms, sample_window_ms, budget_ms, truncated, coverage and a per-section status/reason/detail mirror; these remain opaque metadata.

status.description: failed means host or all core sections are unavailable; the server returns 503 without committing state.

finished_at.description: Valid calendar date/time, timezone required, seconds 00-59 (no leap-second encoding). Supplies receipt.collected_at.

host.description: Top-level host facts (kernel, distribution, uptime, boot id); not a member of sections.

sections.description: Per-section envelopes. Each carries status/reason/detail/sample_window_ms/truncated/parse_errors plus its data fields inline. Optional sections (psi, network, process, io, energy, gpu, log, service, config and the heavy deep-mode sections) may be absent or unavailable.

diagnostics.description: Optional forward-compatible diagnostic evidence (for example a future sysak ai report). Absent in current idc_inspect output; GPU job-level analysis therefore stays not_run.

capabilities.description: Collector read-only declaration; supported_profiles and unsupported_actions remain opaque metadata, not server permissions.

id.description: Copied from the outer app-persistent device_id, not raw device metadata.

Task.description: Synchronous read-only parsing task. simulated is false; missing diagnostics remain unchecked rather than fabricated success.

request_id.description: Present only after successfully parsing a valid envelope request_id.

retryable.description: True only for 503. 409 requires state refresh or a new ID, not blind retry.

AgentWindow.description: Valid calendar timestamps: start <= end <= sampled_at. Window is supplied by the collector, not inferred from row counts.

hooks.description: Optional independent top-level Hook metadata, not a sources entry. Missing is hooks.unavailable; semantic failures return HTTP 200 with hooks.invalid and no Hook rows, without rejecting the request or changing the five AgentSight coverage entries/status.

sources.description: Sources may be missing or unavailable. Invalid individual source content is accepted only to report invalid coverage, not interpreted as evidence. No command lines, paths, user questions or interruption detail fields.

usage.description: Safe integer calls/inputTokens/outputTokens from AgentSight unwindowed /metrics over its retained records; includes auxiliary and unattributed calls. Never add cache tokens again.

sessions.description: Safe integer total from the complete retained-session response before the 500-row detail projection. Incomplete responses remain unknown; AgentSight retention rules still apply.

AgentRawStoredHistory.description: Independent AgentSight retained-history aggregates, separate from the 24h detail window and detail row limits. AgentSight data retention and source completeness still apply; deleted history cannot be recovered. No current-health influence, raw metric labels or conversation content. Individual source failures preserve other sources.

AgentRawSource.description: available/truncated data is validated against the per-source x-valid-data-schema; any invalid row invalidates the entire source. unavailable/invalid requires null data. Oversized lists are capped and marked truncated. These semantic failures return 200 with invalid coverage, not a health assertion.

data.description: JSON or null; never echoed. See per-source x-valid-data-schema for the strictly interpreted projection.

AgentEpochMs.description: Milliseconds since epoch; process scan/check 0 means never scanned/checked and is displayed as null.

AgentEpochNs.description: Nanoseconds since epoch; number precision loss is permitted for display only, never identity or ID comparisons.

AgentRawInterruptionCounts.description: Whole-window unresolved counts, including events beyond the list limit. Total must equal the sum of all four severities.

AgentQuantiles.description: Finite nonnegative p50 <= p95 <= p99; null means no measurement.

AgentRawLatency.description: Complete-call summaries grouped by agent_name, with at most one null-agent group. Empty means available with no complete calls. Invalid or duplicate groups invalidate the entire source; no aggregate quantiles are fabricated.

AgentRawLatencyRow.description: One agent group for complete calls only; streaming_call_count <= call_count. Null agent_name and null quantiles stay null.

AgentHookDateTime.description: Strict valid calendar ISO timestamp with exactly three millisecond digits and Z; must round-trip through Date.toISOString(). Every event is within the inclusive AgentWindow.

AgentHookHistoryActivity.description: Bounded projection of full cumulative metadata: 20 kind counters, at most 12 time bins, 8 irreversibly hashed session rows, 64 tools and 64 subagents. It contains no raw historical events or session IDs.

AgentHookHistory.description: Independent persistent cumulative Hook counters and bounded aggregate charts, accumulated on SQLite writes with permanent event/session deduplication and no counter rotation. Unaffected by time-window, 5000-input, 200-detail or 16-agent limits. Session ranking stores only irreversible (agent, sessionId) hashes; unmatched starts use (agent, sessionId, callId). Records rotated before aggregate enablement cannot be recovered; retained details are backfilled. Only complete available aggregates have numeric totals and activity; other statuses have null totals and activity. Not current-health evidence.

AgentRawHookSource.description: Independent metadata only. available/truncated requires AgentRawHooks data; unavailable/invalid requires null. Malformed source shapes, fields, counts, duplicate event_id, out-of-window events, more than 5000 events or more than 16 distinct agents invalidate the entire Hook source, returning 200 with hooks.invalid (not a request error). No raw Hook data is returned or retained.

data.description: Valid interpreted data is null or AgentRawHooks (see x-valid-data-schema); other JSON is accepted only to report hooks.invalid, never interpreted as evidence.

AgentRawHooks.description: At most 5000 unique event IDs and 16 distinct agents, inclusive report window. skipped_lines is a nonnegative safe integer counting collector-discarded lines; it is not an event or health count. Invalid content discards the entire source, not only invalid rows.

AgentRawHookEvent.description: Exact metadata whitelist. No prompts, tool inputs/outputs, command lines, paths, error body or token usage. IDs are metadata labels, not filesystem access or identity links to AgentSight.

AgentHookAgentSummary.description: Counts cover the full accepted bounded Hook list, not just the recent 200 events. Sessions are distinct non-null Hook session IDs only. toolFailures excludes explicit interrupt=true; interrupts requires tool_failure with interrupt=true. openTools counts unmatched starts by (sessionId, callId) only when both exist; missing completions do not prove a hang.

AgentHookReport.description: Required independent Hook evidence. Missing input means unavailable. unavailable/invalid yields empty arrays and skippedLines=null; available/truncated preserves skippedLines including zero. Agent summaries sort by agent; events are latest-first and limited to 200. Hook status never contributes a sixth AgentSight source or changes its coverage status. Metadata alone is not health; tool failures, cancellation, denial and open starts do not establish an Agent fault.

AgentDiagnostic.description: Exact projection of src/agent-diagnostics-data.ts AgentDiagnostic. status describes evidence coverage, not health. observed asserts observations only, never normal business behavior. Clear events may yield abnormal even with partial coverage; empty, stale or incomplete evidence without clear events yields unknown.

PowerEstimate.description: Known component power in watts with CPU process estimates apportioned by sampled host busy utilization, not normalized to top_n. Unattributed CPU power remains separate. Confirmed GPU absence excludes GPU calculations and uses null gpuWatts without missing GPU coverage. GPU power is not attributed to processes. No cumulative energy or session attribution.

HealthState.description: Collected real evidence in the existing UI layout. Resource usage is independently measured, never summed from top process rows. Unknown percentages are null. Quantities have explicit units. Energy contains known CPU/GPU power subtotals, preferring sensors and falling back to utilization-based estimates with explicit provenance and missing coverage; not whole-system energy or a budget percentage. No Agent/Session attribution, fake history or writable objects.
